description: Intact Property insurance JSON output format configuration (stage 1: based on Intact Auto sections)

last_name.extraction_logic: Extract the applicant's last name (surname). For Intact Auto, prioritize MVR spelling when available. ⚠️ MVR NAME COMMA RULE (HARD RULE): When the MVR shows the applicant name with a COMMA, the comma is the ONLY delimiter you may use to split first_name vs last_name. The text AFTER the comma is the last_name; the text BEFORE the comma is the first_name. NEVER split on whitespace alone — multi-word values on either side of the comma must stay intact (e.g. 'abolo pinker, durlabh' → first_name='abolo pinker', last_name='durlabh'). If the MVR shows the name WITHOUT any comma, do NOT split the printed string yourself; fall back to the Application form's explicit First Name / Last Name fields. MVR may also append a trailing middle name on either side — detect and ignore the middle name so it never becomes first_name or last_name.

first_name.extraction_logic: Extract the applicant's first name. For Intact Auto, prioritize MVR spelling when available. ⚠️ MVR NAME COMMA RULE (HARD RULE): When the MVR shows the applicant name with a COMMA, the comma is the ONLY delimiter you may use to split first_name vs last_name. The text BEFORE the comma is the first_name (keep all words and inner spaces — e.g. 'abolo pinker, durlabh' → first_name='abolo pinker'); the text AFTER the comma is the last_name. NEVER split on whitespace alone. If the MVR shows the name WITHOUT any comma, do NOT split the printed string yourself; fall back to the Application form's explicit First Name / Last Name fields. If MVR appends a trailing middle name, identify and ignore it — do not include middle name in first_name.

gender.extraction_logic: Extract the applicant's gender. Priority: first check application form, if not found check other documents. Must match one of the options: Female, Male, or X.

date_of_birth.extraction_logic: Extract the applicant's date of birth. Priority: first check application form, if not found check other documents. Convert to YYYY-MM-DD format.
date_of_birth.description: Applicant's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

marital_status.extraction_logic: Extract the applicant's marital status. Priority: first check application form, if not found check other documents. Must match one of the options: Divorced, Married, Single, or Widow.

postal_code.extraction_logic: Extract the applicant's postal code from the application (Canadian format X9X9X9, e.g. 'M4C 5L6' or 'M4C5L6').
postal_code.description: Applicant postal code in Canadian format X9X9X9

full_address.extraction_logic: Extract the applicant's full mailing address from the application (street/unit, city, province) without postal code, e.g. '511-5 Massey Sq, East York, ON'.
full_address.description: Applicant full address (street, city, province — no postal code)

phone.extraction_logic: Extract the applicant's primary telephone number from the application (home, cell, or main contact). Output digits only — no hyphens, spaces, parentheses, or other separators (e.g. '4165550100' not '416-555-0100').
phone.description: Applicant primary phone number (digits only, no separators)

email.extraction_logic: Extract the applicant's email address from the application. Use the address exactly as printed.

broker_number.extraction_logic: Extract the broker number from the application form. The broker code may start with a capital letter (e.g., 'X40460', 'A12345'). If it starts with a capital letter, ignore that letter and extract only the numeric part. Output should be 5 digits (e.g., 'X40460' should become '40460').
broker_number.description: 5-digit broker number (numeric part only, ignore leading capital letter if present)

edi_client_code.extraction_logic: Extract the EDI client code from the application form. Look for 'Code:' label followed by the code value (e.g., 'Code: ALEE01' should extract 'ALEE01').

policy_effective_date.description: Policy effective date in YYYY-MM-DD format

risk.description: Risk information in a single `risk` section. Select one independent template by risk_type.
risk.extraction_logic: Extract `risk_type` first, then populate fields ONLY from that template under `fields_by_risk_type`. Do NOT borrow fields or rules across templates.

risk_type.extraction_logic: Identify risk type from Quote text. Quote commonly contains indicators like condominium, homeowner, tenant/renters. Normalize to one allowed option value (e.g. 'Tenants' -> 'Tenant', 'Condominiums' -> 'Condominium').

use.extraction_logic: If there is only one property/risk, set to 'Principal'. If multiple properties/risks exist, follow Quote assignment for each property (e.g., Principal vs Secondary).

owned_resided_since.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Occupied Since. Output in YYYY-MM-DD format.
owned_resided_since.description: Client has owned/resided at this location since (YYYY-MM-DD)

fire_hydrant_within_300m.extraction_logic: Default to 'Yes' for Condominium unless explicit contrary evidence is present.

fire_hall.extraction_logic: Default to 'Within 13km' for Condominium unless explicit contrary evidence is present.

building_type.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Structure. Use keyword/fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Condominium option.

construction_type.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Construction. Use keyword/fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed option.

number_of_units_in_building.extraction_logic: Read from Application first. If not found in Application, output null.

occupancy_status.extraction_logic: Default to 'Occupied' for Condominium unless explicit contrary evidence is present.

smokers_reside_at_this_location.extraction_logic: From Quote header/intro, read 'Smoke-Free Household'. If source is 'Yes', output 'No' for this field. If source is 'No', output 'Yes'.

year_built.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Year Dwelling Build. Output YYYY.

primary_heat_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Primary Heating -> Type. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Central Furnace - Gas'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed option. Example: 'Central Furnace - Gas' -> 'Forced Air Furnace'.

security_or_mitigation_system.extraction_logic: From security section, inspect Burglar Alarm, Fire Alarm, and 24 Hour Video System. Ignore values that indicate none/no/blank. If all three are none/no/blank, output null. Otherwise output a single string that concatenates only present concrete items, e.g. 'Burglar Alarm: XXXX, Fire Alarm: XXXX'.

interest.extraction_logic: All subfields under interest must be sourced from Application (not Quote).

has_loan.extraction_logic: Application source only. Extract whether there is an interested party/loan/credit/mortgage associated with this risk. Must be 'Yes' or 'No'.
has_loan.description: Whether there is an interested party

type_of_interest.extraction_logic: Application source only. Extract type of interest. Select one option from the configured list.

company_name.extraction_logic: Application source only. Extract interested party company or organization name.

address.extraction_logic: Application source only. Extract full mailing address for the interested party.

postal_code.extraction_logic: Application source only. Extract Canadian postal code for the interested party.

use.extraction_logic: If there is only one property/risk, set to 'Principal'. If multiple properties/risks exist, follow Quote assignment for each property (e.g., Principal vs Secondary).

fire_hydrant_within_300m.extraction_logic: Default to 'Yes' for Homeowner unless explicit contrary evidence is present.

fire_hall.extraction_logic: Default to 'Within 13km' for Homeowner unless explicit contrary evidence is present.

building_type.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Structure. Use keyword/fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option.

construction_type.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Construction. Use keyword/fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed option.

exterior_wall_finish.extraction_logic: Extract from Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Exterior Finish (value shown above the label, e.g. 'Brick Veneer'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option.

occupancy_status.extraction_logic: Default to 'Occupied' for Homeowner unless explicit contrary evidence is present. Homeowner also allows Construction, Renovation, and Vacant — use those only when the source clearly indicates them.

smokers_reside_at_this_location.extraction_logic: From Quote header/intro, read 'Smoke-Free Household'. If source is 'Yes', output 'No' for this field. If source is 'No', output 'Yes'.

year_built.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Year Dwelling Build. Output YYYY.

year_of_manufacture.extraction_logic: Extract from Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Year of Manufacture (value above the label). Output 4-digit year YYYY only. If blank, unavailable, or not applicable, output null.

total_living_area.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Total Living Area. Read the value shown above the label (e.g. '1691 sq. ft.') and output the numeric portion only as a positive integer with no units or decimals. If blank or unavailable, output null.
total_living_area.description: Total living area excluding basement (natural number only)

total_living_area_unit.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Total Living Area. Read the unit from the same field as total_living_area and map to one allowed option: 'sq. ft.', 'sq ft', 'square feet' -> 'Sq Feet'; 'sq. m.', 'sq m', 'square meters' -> 'Sq Meters'. Use LLM fuzzy matching when the source wording differs slightly.

number_of_bathrooms.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information only. Read Number of Full Baths and Number of Half Baths (values above each label). Calculate: Number of Full Baths + (0.5 × Number of Half Baths). Example: 3 full + 1 half -> '3.5'. Map the calculated result to one allowed dropdown option.

percent_finished.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Finished Basement. Read the value above the label (e.g. '100%'), strip the '%' symbol, and output an integer from 0 to 100. If blank or unavailable, output null.

garage_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Garage. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Built-in'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option. Example: 'Built-in' -> 'Built in'.

primary_heat_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Primary Heating -> Type. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Central Furnace - Gas'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed option. Example: 'Central Furnace - Gas' -> 'Forced Air Furnace'.

If all three are none/no/blank, output null. Otherwise output a single string that concatenates only present concrete items, e.g. 'Burglar Alarm: XXXX, Fire Alarm: XXXX'.

electrical_wiring_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Type of Electrical. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Copper'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option.

panel_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Electrical Panel. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Breakers'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option.

amperage.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Electrical Service. Read the value above the label (e.g. '100 AMP'), extract the numeric portion, strip 'AMP', and map to one allowed option. Use 'Other' when the source value does not match 60, 100, 125, or 200.

electrical_wiring_update_year.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Year of Electrical. Read the value above the label and output 4-digit year YYYY only. If blank or unavailable, output null.

plumbing_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Type of Plumbing. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Mixed – Copper/PVC'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option. Example: 'Mixed – Copper/PVC' -> 'Copper / PVC'.

plumbing_update_year.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Year of Plumbing. Read the value above the label and output 4-digit year YYYY only. If blank or unavailable, output null.

primary_heat_update_year.extraction_logic: Quote -> Primary Heating -> Year. Read the value above the label under the Primary Heating section and output 4-digit year YYYY only. If blank or unavailable, output null.

roof_covering_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Type of Roof. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Asphalt Shingles'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option.
options: Class 4 Rated Impact Resistant Asphalt Shingles

roofing_update_year.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Year of Roof. Read the value above the label and output 4-digit year YYYY only. If blank or unavailable, output null.

date_evaluation_completed.extraction_logic: Quote -> Policy Information -> Last Home Evaluation. Read the value above the label and output in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: '02/24/2026' -> '2026-02-24'. If blank or unavailable, output null.

rebuilding_cost.extraction_logic: Quote -> Policy Information -> Dwelling Value. Read the value above the label (e.g. '$728,700'). Strip currency symbols and commas; output the numeric amount only. If blank or unavailable, output null.

coverages.description: Dynamic coverages extracted from Quote coverage list.
coverages.extraction_logic: From the Quote document (coverage list section near the end), extract EVERY row under the Coverage column in order. Create dynamic keys using the exact coverage names from Quote. Do NOT use any fixed/predefined coverage field names. Include rows even when amount and/or deductible are blank. For blank cells, output null. Do NOT drop rows because of missing amount/deductible. This includes standard rows and discount/surcharge style rows (for example 'my Home and Auto'). For each row, output an object with amount and deductible only.

COVERAGE_NAME.description: Dynamic coverage item. The key must be the coverage name from Quote (for example: 'Contents', 'Liability', 'Sewer Backup', etc.).

amount.extraction_logic: Extract the Amount-column value for this exact coverage row. Preserve printed value format when possible. If the Amount cell is blank or not provided for this row, output null (but keep the row).
amount.description: Coverage amount/limit for this coverage item

deductible.extraction_logic: Extract the Deductible-column value for this exact coverage row. If the Deductible cell is blank or not provided for this row, output null (but keep the row).
deductible.description: Coverage deductible for this coverage item

insured_with_broker_since.extraction_logic: Extract from Application first. If previous_insurer is 'No Prior Insurer' (no past insurance), use term.policy_effective_date. Otherwise extract insured-since date from Application. Output in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must not be null.

insured_without_interruption_since.extraction_logic: Must equal insured_with_broker_since. Extract from Application first; if previous_insurer is 'No Prior Insurer', use term.policy_effective_date. Output in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must not be null.
insured_without_interruption_since.description: Insured without interruption since (YYYY-MM-DD), equal to insured_with_broker_since

previous_insurer.extraction_logic: Extract Previous Insurer for property policy. Use LLM fuzzy matching against Intact Property dropdown options and output one normalized option label. If source indicates no prior insurer/new business, output 'No Prior Insurer'. If insurer is Canadian/U.S. but not found in list, output 'Other Canada or U.S. Insurer not on the list'. If outside Canada/U.S., output 'Outside of Canada or U.S.'.
previous_insurer.description: Previous insurer selected from Intact Property dropdown options.
options: Other Canada or U.S. Insurer not on the list
State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company
TD Home and Auto Insurance Company
TD Home and Auto Insurance Company (FA)

number_of_years_with_previous_insurer.extraction_logic: Conditional field. Only include this key when previous_insurer is NOT 'No Prior Insurer'. Extract from Application field 'Number of Years with Previous Insurer'. Output numeric years only. If previous_insurer is 'No Prior Insurer', omit this key entirely.
number_of_years_with_previous_insurer.description: Number of years with previous insurer

previous_insurer_policy_number.extraction_logic: Conditional field. Only include this key when previous_insurer is NOT 'No Prior Insurer'. Extract from Application field 'Previous Insurer Policy Number'. Keep the policy number exactly as shown. If previous_insurer is 'No Prior Insurer', omit this key entirely.

previous_insurer_expiry_date.extraction_logic: Conditional field. Only include this key when previous_insurer is NOT 'No Prior Insurer'. Extract from Application field 'Expiry Date'. Output in YYYY-MM-DD format. If previous_insurer is 'No Prior Insurer', omit this key entirely.

premium_on_quote.description: Premium on quote — final total automobile policy premium as printed on the Quote document.
premium_on_quote.extraction_logic: Use ONLY the Quote document (ignore Application, MVR, AutoPlus for this value). Find the final policy premium the insured pays — the bottom-line total on the quote summary, often labeled 'Total Premium', 'Annual Premium', 'Total Policy Premium', 'Premium', 'Total', or similar on the last premium/payment summary section. If the quote shows per-vehicle premiums and a policy-level grand total, use the grand total. If only one clear total appears, use that. Preserve the value as printed (digits; $ and commas optional if shown). Do not substitute per-coverage line amounts. If no total can be identified on the quote, output null. IMPORTANT: emit this value as a single JSON string at the root key `premium_on_quote` only — do NOT nest it inside an object (no `total` or other wrapper).
